dcp.name: No DCP located. Council policy: Building Setback Policy (not a DCP)

front.note: 6m from primary street boundary, all roads and streets.

rules.document: Balranald Shire Council Building Setback Policy (v2.0, adopted 2018 Min 08.18.4387, reviewed August 2025 Min 2025/140)
rules.clause: cl 1 (front), cl 2 and Table 1 (secondary), cl 3 (cul-de-sac), cl 4 (reduction)
rules.quote: A general residential building line setback of 6m minimum, measured from the primary street boundary
rules.reviewReason: Extracted via tool; page numbers not available. Secondary table quote: 'A setback in accordance with Table 1 applies to the secondary street frontage on corner allotments.' Cul-de-sac: 'minimum 4m in the straight area and minimum 3m in the turning area' (cl 3). Cl 4: 'Residential building line setbacks may be reduced by Council in exceptional circumstances.'

gaps: Policy is a council policy, not a DCP; it states no side, rear or garage setbacks.
No Balranald DCP found on council site (planning page lists the LEP and a 'Building setback Policy' only).
notes: Policy listed under Planning Policies on https://balranald.nsw.gov.au/infrastructure/planning-and-development-applications (page does not name a DCP). Side/rear fall back to Part 3D Inland Code. Part 3D Inland Code of the Codes SEPP applies to this LGA (named in cl 3D.1(4)); see fallback/nsw-inland-code.json. Not a DCP control. Secondary table matches cl 3D.21 secondary table.
